identitySummary: Elegant tapered Column with a rounded asymmetric head, broad swept-back burgundy fin, two calm half-lidded eyes, long recessed front panel, joined resting hands, and a flared legless base.
promptSummary: Identity-reference-only flat-first Palari mark using ivory #E9E6DF, burgundy #6E202C, and background-only navy #172333; lower-right crop; 6–10 rounded shapes; exact six-aperture large-small-large seed; no mouth, scene, texture, realism, or discrete shading.
deviations: The navy background retains a visible center-to-edge tonal variation instead of a perfectly uniform field.
The burgundy fin and opening drift brighter than the requested #6E202C base.
